geometry.domain: one quadrant of one drop: axis r=0, symmetry plane z=0, free surface S(t)

nondimensionalization.time: mu*R_drop/gamma  (viscocapillary, t_VC; density does not enter)
nondimensionalization.reference: Anthony, Harris & Basaran, PRF 5, 033608 (2020), Sec. II.A

mesh.resolution_role: reconstructed controlled-Q2 pilot; repeat at 4, 8 and 16 for convergence because Anthony et al. do not publish their element counts
mesh.remesh_rule: remesh whenever R_min has grown by a factor of 4 (Anthony 2020, Sec. II.B.2)
mesh.bridge_region: ellipse of Eq. 6: z1=R_min (R_min<1/2), r2=2*R_min, slope tan(pi/3) at axis, 0 at plane; lagged one step

output.cadence_unit: decades of R_min (log10) between diagnostic records; states also written at every remesh
output.cadence_rule: every remesh and every decade of R_min

completion.note: Operational gate: one accepted physical timestep, live remesh calibration, immutable checkpoint and progress receipt; max_time remains the safety endpoint

provenance.reproduces: Pre-remesh operational gate for Fig. 3 Stokes case
provenance.note: Same exact published initial bridge and level-8 pilot mesh as T5 Stokes; this case stops successfully after one accepted physical timestep and is not a Fig. 3 validation trajectory.
